name: Bell Tower (CR 6)
body:
A bell-ringer fell down in this tower. Before he died he wished that the fall hadn’t happened…

XP 2,400; NE haunt (the inner shaft of the bell tower, 10 ft. wide and 60 ft. high); Caster Level 6th; Notice Perception DC 0 (to notice the bell starting to ring); hp 12; Trigger proximity; Reset 1 week

EFFECT

When this haunt is triggered, the bell starts to ring as the ghostly body of the bell-ringer falls to the ground. A moment later the same scene goes in reverse, with the body flying upwards together with everything inside the inner shaft of the bell tower. For six rounds the inner shaft of the bell tower is affected by reverse gravity (DC 20 Reflex save to hold onto the ladder).

DESTRUCTION

The bell must be broken by dropping it from the tower.
